verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity-management SaaS. A product of this kind could plausibly embed an AI assistant that consumes external MCP tools, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents an OAuth service-account API, cap-table operations and HRIS integrations. Nothing shows Ledgy can connect to or use MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
